site_name: Microsoft SAT15, 3555 Westover Link, San Antonio, TX 78251
verification: The TDLR record matches the site (SAT15 Data Center, 3555 Westover Link) and shows Registration 8/18/2022, Start 10/1/2022, Completion 5/1/2026, status "Inspection Complete". It does not support 2026 as the first-operation year to the required standard: (1) the page carries no inspection date, no closed date, and no label saying whether the completion date is actual or the registrant's estimate; the status is not "Project Closed"; (2) "Inspection Complete" implies construction finished at some point (the page cites 16 TAC 68.52, inspection follows completion), but that could have been 2024, 2025, or 2026; (3) San Antonio Report (Aug 7, 2023) said of the Highway 151 at Westover Link site, "It is expected to be completed in early 2024," which conflicts with a 2026 reading. No page I opened states the building is operating, open, or delivered. Later San Antonio Report pieces (Mar 2025, Dec 2025) do not mention this site's status. The second TDLR record (TABS2024013318) is a separate 245,000 sq ft new-construction data center registration (start 8/1/2024, completion 12/1/2025, status Project Registered); the fetch tool indicated facility label "SAT 16" but withheld the address, so I could not tie it to this campus and it does not date SAT15. Caveat on method: the fetch tool's summarizer declined to reproduce the full TDLR fields verbatim, so name/address were confirmed by yes/no answers and the quote is limited to the status string. Plausible range for true first operation is 2024-2026 (inference, not verified).
